description:
What really happens to recycled Aluminum? Can Aluminum Be recycled? How do I recycle aluminum? Today we answer all of those questions while touring Constellium, one of the worlds largest aluminum recycling facilities on the planet. (https://www.constellium.com/) 

This video is not sponsored.
